title: Baade Rasool Sadme
body:
baade rasool sadme uthaati rahi batool
rone ko bait e huzn mein jaati rahi batool
<<DIVIDER>>
dil murtaza ka pehle hi zakhmon se choor hai
maula se apne zakhm chupati rahi batool
baade rasool sadme...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehlu shakista ho ke bhi shikwa nahi kiya
tanhaiyon mein ashk bahaati rahi batool
baade rasool sadme...
<<DIVIDER>>
dene hai khutbe unko bhi darbar e shaam mein
zainab ko dil ka haal bataati rahi batool
baade rasool sadme...
<<DIVIDER>>
afsos ke liye bhi na aaya koi magar
farshe ghame rasool bichati rahi batool
baade rasool sadme...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ke dukhon pe rote rahe zainab o hussain
yasrab mein karbala ko sajaati rahi batool
baade rasool sadme...
<<DIVIDER>>
darwaza e batool se uth'ta raha dhuaan
ajre rasool durron se paati rahi batool
baade rasool sadme...
<<DIVIDER>>
cheh maah bhi na zinda rahi bibi ay zafar
nauhe musibaton ke sunaati rahi batool
baade rasool sadme...
author: Zafar Abbas
